referential.article:
Customer will delegate to CFM approval of all DICA (Deviation of Instruction for Continuous Airworthiness) / DR (Departure Record) which do not include any follow-up inspection, repair or part replacement on-wing. CFM will have to obtain written approval from Customer to accept a DICA/DR with a follow-up requirement on-wing. {Customer agrees to respond to CFM's request within [Business_day]
Business Day to confirm approval.}

Non-OEM Parts and Non-OEM Repairs. Upon execution and throughout the Term of the Service Agreement, Customer shall make all commercially reasonable effort to identify in good faith the existence of Non-OEM Parts or Non-OEM Repairs. 

If Non-OEM Parts or Non-OEM Repairs are exposed during the shop visit, then such parts or repairs shall be removed, sent back to Customer and replaced with OEM parts on a Time and Material Basis.

If Non-OEM Parts or Non-OEM Repairs are exposed during the shop visit, and the Parties were unaware of the existence of such Non-OEM Parts or Non-OEM Repairs, CFM will, at the option of Customer, either:

i.	remove and send such parts or repaired parts back to Customer and replace such with OEM parts on a Time and Material Basis, or 
ii.	reinstall the Non-OEM Parts or Non-OEM Repairs, if Customer determines such parts or repairs to be Serviceable, in their current condition, without the need for repair, Customer shall provide to CFM regulatory documentation confirming such Serviceability (including, but not limited to, the Authorized Release Certificate and all applicable accompanying documentation).

Customer shall return to CFM such removed Non-OEM Part or Non-OEM Repair in Serviceable condition within a mutually-agreed period and any resulting adverse effects notably to Engine TAT will be mutually agreed, and the original TAT (if any) will be increased by the agreed Days from its removal. If Customer fails to return the Serviceable Non-OEM Part or Non-OEM Repair within this mutually-agreed period, it will be replaced by an OEM-part on a Time and Material Basis. For the avoidance of doubt, Non-OEM Parts or Non-OEM Repairs that can only be returned to a Serviceable condition following repair are not eligible for reinstallation under this provision. LLP hardware operated with influencing Non-OEM Parts or Non-OEM Repairs per Chapter 5 of the appropriate CFM approved shop manual and any relevant Service Bulletin concerning Critical Influencing Parts will be considered influenced by unknown operational conditions and replacement will be recommended by CFM. CFM shall only reinstall if feasible pursuant to the Engine Shop Manual as determined by Customer. Non-OEM Parts or Non-OEM Repairs that are not exposed during a shop visit shall remain in an Engine.

For shipment of the parts or repairs pursuant to this Paragraph “Non-OEM Parts and Non-OEM Repairs”, Customer shall arrange and pay for transportation. Customer shall pay for any related costs associated with determining that any unknown Non-OEM Part or Non-OEM Repair is Serviceable (without the need for repair, as outlined above) with appropriate documentation.

In addition Customer, on behalf of itself, its predecessors, successors, and assigns, direct and indirect parent companies, direct and indirect affiliated companies, hereby respectively release and discharge CFM and agrees to defend, indemnify and hold harmless CFM from all known and unknown charges, claims, liabilities, obligations, promises, damages, losses, debts, penalties, fees, wages, expenses (including attorneys' fees and costs actually incurred) of any nature whatsoever, known or unknown, which Customer and/or any third party may have had or may have against CFM, whether or not apparent or yet to be discovered, or which may hereafter develop, for any acts or omissions related to or arising from reinstallation of the Non-OEM Parts or Non-OEM Repairs or Influenced CFM LLPs. For the purpose of this article/paragraph(s) CFM shall mean CFM, GE and SafranAE, the CFM Designated Repair Station and CFM’s subsidiaries, assigns, subcontractors, suppliers, Services providers, and their respective directors, officers, employees, and agents.

This Services warranty is applicable only if the Engine/Parts, following Redelivery,

(a) has been transported, stored, installed, operated, handled, maintained, repaired in accordance with the then-current CFM recommendations as stated in AMM or CFM manuals, Airworthiness Directives, Service Bulletins, and other relevant written instructions

(b) has not been altered, modified or repaired by anyone other than the CFM Designated Repair Station; and 

(c) has not been subjected to accident, misuse, abuse or neglect.

{[2] Any warranty for warranted Parts will be the warranty, if any, of the manufacturer of such warranted Parts.}

{[1] Any warranty for Engines or parts, Engine Controls and Accessories, components and material thereof, including the design, material or engineering defects of a manufacturer, will be the warranty, if any, ofthe manufacturer of such Engines or parts, Engine Controls and Accessories, components or material thereof.}

{[3]The foregoing will constitute the sole remedy of Customer and the sole liability of CFM for defective
workmanship relative to the Engines. The liability of CFM connected with or resulting from the Services
warranty shall not in any event exceed the cost of correcting the defect as provided above, and, upon
the expiration of the shortest period described therein, all such liability will terminate. In no event shall
CFM be liable for any special, expectation, consequential, incidental, resultant, indirect, punitive or
exemplary damages (including loss of use, loss of profit or loss of revenue in connection with the
Engines).}

Customer may not assign the Services warranty without CFM’s prior written consent. However, CFM will consent to a Services warranty assignment to Customer’s lessor upon written request, subject to the terms and conditions of a mutually agreed warranty assignment letter.

Customer will assure that any requested repair of an Engine, accessory or component that is covered under a third party warranty that is not assigned to CFM will be performed directly by that person at no expense to CFM. Notwithstanding the above, CFM may accept a purchase order for the time and material repair of a warranted item from Customer or the person giving the warranty.
